changelog:
Initial release of the "discuss-before-begin" skill:

- Provides a structured, adversarial discussion process to clarify and challenge plans, requirements, and ideas before implementation.
- Enforces rigorous requirement mapping, ambiguity elimination, and explicit conflict resolution using a decision tree model.
- Guides users through round-by-round questioning, surfacing hidden assumptions, risks, and opportunity costs.
- Includes a "blind-spot closure" phase to proactively seek unconsidered failure points and ensure all ambiguities are explicitly resolved.
- Maintains a strict separation: no implementation begins until the user confirms consensus; hands off to documentation and task breakdown before any coding.
